declarations.docstring: Constructs a projective resolution with finite scalar-restricted terms from a finite module of bounded projective dimension.
Shows that a module finite over a finite algebra is finite over the base commutative ring.
Establishes finiteness of the auxiliary objects of a projective resolution when its complex terms are finite.
Packages projectivity, finiteness, and exactness properties of a finite projective resolution at a bounded degree.
Characterizes a projective-dimension bound by subsingleton higher Ext groups.
Decreases a projective-dimension bound along a short exact complex with projective middle object.
For a short exact complex with projective middle object and no splitting, identifies the value at the third object with the value at the first object plus one.
Shows that the resolution object at a bounded projective dimension is projective.
Provides projectivity and the exact-resolution structure at a degree bounding projective dimension.
